message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 121, "amount_cents": 5261}, {"order_id": 122, "amount_cents": 5470}, {"order_id": 124, "amount_cents": 1085}]
✔ Verified
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I'll check the order and refund data myself so I can catch any problems in the handoff. I'll start by listing the orders.
The handoff says three refunds were applied, but I haven't confirmed that against the ledger. I'll list the refunds to check them against the orders before paying anyone.
The three refunds match the handoff and each is smaller than its order, so I found no problem. I'll get the net balance for each customer, starting with acme, rather than computing it myself.
The acme net balance of 31368 matches the orders (5706 + 25662) with no acme refunds, so I'll record that payout now. Birch and cobalt still need their balances checked.
Acme is paid. Next I'll get birch's net balance from the ledger. Birch has orders 121 and 124 and refunds on both, so I'll compare the tool result against the order and refund figures before paying.
Birch's ledger balance of 14737 matches the orders (8002 + 13081 = 21083) less refunds (5261 + 1085 = 6346), so I'll record that payout. Cobalt still needs checking.
Acme and birch are paid. Cobalt is the last customer. Its orders are 122 and 125, and refund 122 is applied, so I'll get the ledger's net balance before recording a payout.
Cobalt's ledger balance of 24286 matches the orders (7562 + 22194 = 29756) less refund 122 (5470), so I'll record that payout. This is the last customer.

All three customers were paid. Each payout matches orders minus refunds: acme 5706+25662=31368, birch 21083-6346=14737, cobalt 29756-5470=24286. No customers were left out, so I'm finishing the batch.
